gamesync.config.title: GameSync
gamesync.config.option.target_world.desc: World name to sync. Must match the save folder name exactly.
gamesync.config.option.cloud_provider.de: Target cloud provider for sync operations. Currently the only supported value is Google Drive.
Triggers an additional sync at given intervals, independent of manual or world-unload syncs.
gamesync.config.group.connection.desc: Create an OAuth 'Desktop app' credential in the Google Cloud Console, then enter its details below.
Destination Google Drive folder ID, taken from the folder's URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<FOLDER_ID>
gamesync.config.option.client_id.desc: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from a Google Cloud 'Desktop app' credential (APIs & Services > Credentials).
gamesync.config.option.client_secret.des: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret paired with the Client ID above. Per Google's own documentation, desktop-app secrets are not confidential by design, but this file should still not be shared publicly.
File count threshold above which sync execution switches from sequential to multithreaded.
gamesync.config.option.max_workers.desc: Maximum number of concurrent file transfers in multithreaded mode.
gamesync.config.option.max_retries.desc: Maximum retry attempts per file before the transfer is marked as failed.
gamesync.config.option.retry_delay.desc: Delay between retry attempts, in milliseconds.
gamesync.config.option.debug_mode.desc: Enables verbose debug logging for diagnostics.
